claims.claim: BioInterfaceBench freezes 16 instances across 8 families under an 8/8 split.
The public and hidden benchmark layers remain separated, with 16 graded instances and no target exposure.
Five named statistical baselines and four representations run under the frozen split.
The extraction fixture reports accuracy 0.500, while its high-confidence subset reaches precision 1.000 and recall 1.000.
The coverage audit counts 7 independent studies, 4 missing dimension values, and 4 gaps without imputation.
The scientific-agent suite covers 7 tasks and selects the single_agent mode under equal fixture quality metrics.
All reported benchmark claims remain limited to the frozen development fixture and do not use hidden target values.
Coverage gaps, extraction errors, abstentions, and failure taxonomies remain visible in the draft evidence package.
